name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, serves per-site static content, applies Fail2Ban, firewall, and SSH hardening, and generates development self-signed certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis password authentication, logging, replication-setting cleanup, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a FastAPI tutorial application from GitHub with a Python virtual environment, dependencies, local PostgreSQL database and user, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
